reopened_reason: EW-RS-077 fixes the common plus/minus coupling frontier and exposes a joint D/A directional constraint plus a structurally reducible C mode-label redundancy.

new_assertions.body: C sign direction is common-redundant in the tested RS-077 carrier: every one of the thirteen common-exact D/A coupling pairs remains exact under every C coupling mode.

D/A sign direction is relocatable but jointly necessary: every common-exact candidate keeps SIGNED_NET or SEPARATED in at least one of D or A, while neither family is individually forced to keep direction.
The frozen D/A Pareto frontier has four incomparable mode pairs: TOTAL+SIGNED_NET, SIGNED_NET+TOTAL, ABS_NET+SEPARATED, and SEPARATED+ABS_NET.

The formal twelve-candidate Pareto frontier factors exactly as three incomparable C mode labels {TOTAL,SIGNED_NET,ABS_NET} times the four D/A Pareto pairs; the verifier therefore must retain all twelve formal minima.
At this sign-coupling layer 6x3-k4 is the transfer discriminator: it accepts 65 of 125 candidates, exactly the common-exact set; 6x3-k3 accepts all 125 and 4x5-k4 accepts 80.
Sign-channel coupling removes additional scalar-null structure: Pareto-minimal carriers reach rank 250 from 252 on 4x5-k4 and rank 13 from 14 on 6x3-k4 while preserving the full scalar image.

Arithmetic coupling of saturated symbols must preserve set-valued source semantics. A symbol 1+, 2+, or 3+ denotes an interval of exact counts; treating it as an exact integer would reintroduce information discarded by EW-RS-076.

On the frozen C presence alphabet {0,1+}^2, TOTAL, ABS_NET, and UNORDERED_PAIR induce the same three structural classes {neither sign present, exactly one sign present, both signs present}; SIGNED_NET and SEPARATED induce the same four ordered classes. This equivalence is outcome-independent.

Because a three-class C partition is already common-exact, the next structural experiment may replace C coupling-mode labels by the canonical active-sign-support cardinality 0/1/2 without scalar replay or loss of the tested C quotient.

The four D/A Pareto mode pairs are closed under exchanging the mode assignments between D and A, but this does not establish semantic interchangeability of the D and A alphabets; it is a frontier symmetry only.

Independent per-family minimization is no longer sound for D and A because exactness is relational across the two families. The next lawful reduction must treat the joint D/A pair state as the object of compression.
EW-RS-059 remains sealed: RS-077 freezes only a structural sign-channel frontier and does not define a closed scalar syndrome.
